title: A High-Order Compact Finite Volume Method for Unstructured Grids: Scheme Space Formulation and One-Dimensional Implementations
summary: This paper presents a novel and straightforward compact reconstruction procedure for the high-order finite volume method on unstructured grids. In this procedure, we constructed a linear approximation relationship between the mean values and the function values, as well as the derivative values. Compared with the classical compact schemes, which employ a Taylor expansion method to determine the coefficients, our approach adopts an equivalent and more generalized method to achieve this goal.
